mapper.update: UPDATE yc_ai_model_work SET generation_status = 'READY', storage_status = 'TEMPORARY', model_url = #{modelUrl}, cover_url = #{coverUrl}, model_format = #{modelFormat}, generated_at = #{generatedAt}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, last_error = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND generation_status IN ('SUBMITTED', 'RUNNING')

UPDATE yc_ai_model_work SET storage_status = 'PERSISTING', persist_started_at = NOW(), persist_charge_status = #{chargeStatus}, last_error = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND storage_status IN ('TEMPORARY', 'PERSIST_FAILED') AND persist_charge_status IN ('NONE', 'REFUNDED', 'FREE') AND expires_at > DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 10 MINUTE)

mapper.delete: DELETE FROM yc_ai_model_work WHERE status = 1 AND generation_status = 'READY' AND storage_status IN ('TEMPORARY', 'PERSIST_FAILED') AND expires_at IS NOT NULL AND expires_at <= NOW()
